The update on Powell is pretty vague, and hamstring are notoriously tricky, but it’s noteworthy that the team used “mild” to describe the strain, tweets K.C. […]

articles.title: Why Walter Clayton Jr. spurned other West teams and joined his college roommate on the Mavs
articles.summary: “Just felt like this would be a good spot, all things considered," Clayton said about signing with Dallas in October.

articles.title: Darius Acuff Jr. leads Kings to slump-busting win over Celtics: 'That was a great feeling'
articles.summary: Acuff scored nine of his 21 points in the final three minutes of a 97-96 stunner over the short-handed Celtics.

articles.title: In a New York minute: Did Mikal Bridges just turn his season around with one shot?
articles.summary: Bridges sunk the Blazers with his second-career buzzer-beater on Saturday, and the Knicks are hoping it snaps him out of his funk
